Request to Amend the 2026-2027 Official Compensation Schedule to include the pay range of $114,881 - $175,344 for the classification of Chief Assessor and create a new title of Associate Director of Appraisal and Valuation for the Department of Office of Chief Financial Officer. (A classification and compensation review was conducted for two positions within the Valuation & Field Operations division of the Office of the Assessor. The review determined that the existing Associate Director of Strategic Affairs job specification did not reflect the duties currently performed by the incumbent. As a result, a new title and corresponding job specification, Associate Director of Appraisal and Valuation, were developed to accurately capture the scope of work being performed. The new classification retains the incumbent's existing pay range; there is no increase in pay associated with this title change. The review further identified an internal equity issue between the Chief Assessor and Associate Director of Appraisal and Valuation titles, which perform substantially similar work based on scope and volume but are assigned to different salary ranges. Aligning the Chief Assessor salary range with the comparable classification resolves this inconsistency.)

Community Blight Court Initiative Update. (The City of Detroit’s Department of Appeals and Hearings (DAH) is pleased to announce the launch of our Community Blight Court Initiative beginning on August 12th, 2026, at the Crowell Recreation Center in Council District 1. Community Blight Court brings administrative hearings directly into Detroit neighborhoods by holding in-person blight court sessions at recreation centers and community hubs throughout the City. This initiative is designed to make the administrative hearing process more accessible by reducing barriers to participation and bringing City services closer to the residents and businesses we serve. It reflects DAH's ongoing commitment to equitable access to justice and advancing neighborhood-focused government.)
